name: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited

facts.business: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited operates in the shipping and offshore sectors, owning and operating crude tankers, product tankers, LPG carriers, and offshore assets.
key_risks: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia and Middle East disrupting tanker markets
Higher newbuilding deliveries in LR2 and MR segments increasing fleet supply
Tanker orderbook uptick (crude ~20% of fleet, product ~19% of fleet) creating supply-side pressure
Higher oil prices and softer macroeconomic environment weighing on refined product demand
Uncertainty in duration of Middle East conflict and transit levels through Strait of Hormuz
